faq.q1: How does AI expense tracking work?
faq.a1: Our AI uses advanced pattern recognition to categorize your transactions automatically and predict future spending based on historical data.
faq.a2: Yes, we use bank-grade encryption and isolated processing nodes to ensure your data remains private and secure at all times.
faq.a3: Absolutely! You can export your transactions and financial reports as CSV files from the Transactions and AI Predictions pages.
faq.q4: How do I set up a budget?
faq.a4: Navigate to the Goal Planner to set financial milestones, or use the AI Suggestions in your dashboard to set category limits.
faq.a5: Finco currently supports English, Hindi, and Telugu. You can change your language in the Settings menu.
faq.a6: Accuracy improves as you log more data. Typically, after 2-3 months of consistent logging, predictions achieve over 90% accuracy.
